alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a window. A small amber block figure with white eyes stands on the left, ready, facing a digital clock on the right that reads 9:56. It watches the minutes tick, 9:57, 9:58, 9:59, and stretches tall each time. At 9:59 it glances away and its eyes close. The clock reaches 10:00 and then 10:01 while it is not looking. When it looks back its eyes go wide and it trembles. In the last seconds the text changes from: me starting at 10:00, to: it's 10:01. next hour then. It narrows its eyes at the camera.
